table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	issueheader.issueinvcode,
	issueheader.referenceno,
	issueheader.date,
	recipienttype = recipient.name,
	recipient = CASE :ai_recipientcode When 1 Then (select name from department where deptcode = issueheader.deptcode and deptcode in (:ai_recipientlist) ) When 2 Then (Select Name From Accounts Where subcode = 3 and acccode=issueheader.acccode and acccode in (:ai_recipientlist) ) When 3 Then (Select Name from accounts where acccode=issueheader.acccode and acccode in (:ai_recipientlist) ) When 4 Then (Select name from salesman where salesmancode = issueheader.recipientsalesman and salesmancode in (:ai_recipientlist) ) End, 
	item.name,
	item.customicode, 
	issuedetail.qty,
	issuedetail.batch,
	issuedetail.expiry,
	issuedetail.price,
	amount=issuedetail.qty * issuedetail.price
FROM
	issueheader,
	issuedetail,
	item, 
	recipient
WHERE  
	dbo.issueheader.date Between :ad_StartDate and :ad_EndDate and
	issueheader.recipientcode = :ai_recipientcode and
	issueheader.recipientcode = recipient.recipientcode and
	issueheader.issueinvcode=issuedetail.issueinvcode and
	issuedetail.icode=item.icode 
ORDER BY 
	issueheader.issueinvcode
